metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.7 · 2005 · Fantastic Four
metas.description: A group of astronauts gain superpowers after a cosmic radiation exposure and must use them to oppose the plans of their enemy, Doctor Victor Von Doom.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.6 · 2007 · Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
metas.description: The Fantastic Four learn that they aren't the only super-powered beings in the universe when they square off against the powerful Silver Surfer and the planet-eating Galactus.
